result.instructions: Tools for Rise.ai, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the store credit balance of the customer with this email address."; "Show the last 20 store credit transactions on this wallet."; "Which gift card orders are still waiting to be fulfilled?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Rise.ai data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run riseai_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run riseai_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run riseai_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. riseai_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: riseai_query_wallets
tools.title: Query store credit wallets
tools.description: Find store credit wallets (one per customer balance), enriched with gift card and contact information. Use the filter for an email or customer reference. Rise API: POST /v1/rise/wallets/query.

filter.description: Filter as field name → value, e.g. {"email": "buyer@example.com"}. Operators such as {"$contains": "x"} also work. Field names follow the Rise API Query Language.

offset.description: Items to skip in the current sort order.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous response's pagingMetadata. When set, filter, sort and limit are ignored.
